 UFC Doha: Prochazka vs. Stirling keeps the prelims moving with an intriguing lightweight matchup between Brazilian striker Nikolas Motta and Australian Road to UFC winner Dom Mar Fan. Check out our UFC Doha odds series for our Motta-Mar Fan prediction and pick.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Nikolas Motta (15-6, 1 NC) returns to action following a 17-month layoff looking to erase a tough stoppage defeat. He was stopped via second-round TKO punches by Nazim Sadykhov in June 2025 after previously earning a clean unanimous decision over Maheshate Hayisaer in November 2024 as he comes into his fight this weekend against Dom Mar Fan.
 Dom Mar Fan (9-3) seeks a quick rebound after suffering a stunning first-round upset loss in his sophomore UFC appearance. The 26-year-old Australian fell via first-round inverted heel hook to Kody Steele in May after previously defeating Sang Wook Kim by unanimous decision at UFC 325 in January as he comes into his fight this weekend against Nikolas Motta.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement UFC Doha Odds: Nikolas Motta-Dom Mar Fan Odds 
 Nikolas Motta: +145
 Dom Mar Fan: -175
 Over 2.5 rounds: +100
 Under 2.5 rounds: -130
 Why Nikolas Motta Will Win 
 Nikolas Motta brings proven UFC knockout power and heavy Nova União boxing that can punish anyone who leaves defensive gaps early. Having knocked out Tom Nolan in 63 seconds and Cameron VanCamp in the first round, Motta knows how to detonate bombs when opponents step into pocket range.
 Although he is returning from a 17-month hiatus, that extended recovery time may have served Motta well after his violent war with Nazim Sadykhov. His clean 30-27 shutout of Maheshate Hayisaer also proved he can fight disciplined, crisp boxing across 15 minutes when he manages his gas tank properly.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Dom Mar Fan was just caught cleanly in the opening round by Kody Steele in May, showing he can still make costly split-second errors under UFC lights. Because Motta averages zero takedowns and commits fully to standing exchanges, his game plan is simple and laser-focused.
 If Motta slips Mar Fan's longer jab, crashes inside the pocket, and rips heavy hooks to the body and head, he carries the far bigger knockout threat. Landing cleanly early could easily turn this into an upset stoppage for the veteran Brazilian.
 Why Dom Mar Fan Will Win 
 Dom Mar Fan holds huge advantages in youth, size, reach, and overall MMA versatility heading into this lightweight clash. At 26 years old, he is seven years younger than Motta and enjoys a massive five-inch reach advantage at 75 inches compared to Motta's 70.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Mar Fan's clean three-round shutouts through Road to UFC Season 4 and UFC 325 demonstrated composed range management, sharp cardio, and reliable grappling. Because Motta has zero recorded takedown or submission offense in the UFC, Mar Fan doesn't have to worry about being outwrestled.
 Instead, the Australian can dictate the distance with long jabs and kicks before shooting reactive takedowns whenever Motta overextends on big punches. Motta's durability has also been tested severely in the Octagon, suffering knockout losses to Jim Miller, Manuel Torres, and Nazim Sadykhov.
 Coming off a 17-month layoff at 33 years old, Motta's timing and cardio could fade quickly if Mar Fan forces him to chase range and defend clinch work. Mixing clean outside striking with timely grappling entries gives Mar Fan multiple comfortable paths to victory.
 Click Above to Subscribe Final Motta-Mar Fan Prediction & Pick 
 Dom Mar Fan is the pick because his five-inch reach edge, youth, and well-rounded attack should neutralize Nikolas Motta's one-dimensional boxing. Motta's 17-month layoff is a major red flag against an active, hungry 26-year-old prospect looking to bounce right back from a fluke leg-lock loss.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Motta's early power always keeps him dangerous during the opening five minutes, especially if Mar Fan gets sloppy exiting exchanges. However, Motta's tendency to fade and absorb heavy shots past round one plays right into Mar Fan's disciplined, three-round grinding style.
 Expect Mar Fan to stay long early, avoid trading hooks in the phone booth, and mix in timely takedowns once Motta slows down. By mixing range striking with smart mat control, Mar Fan should earn a clean unanimous decision victory.
 Final Nikolas Motta-Dom Mar Fan Prediction & Pick: Dom Mar Fan (-175), OVER 2.5 rounds (+100)
